blurb: Enjoy a wide range of amenities and fun activities at one of New Hampshire’s top-rated (and largest) campgrounds! Nestled on 108 acres in Weare, NH, Cold Springs Camp Resort is your perfect family camping getaway and is conveniently located only 30 minutes from both Concord and Manchester, NH. The Resort is known for its cleanliness and expansive pool complex featuring 5 pools, 2 waterslides, and 2 hot tubs.
